title: SafeAreaView does not have setNativeProps like View

labels.name: Resolution: Locked
labels.description: This issue was locked by the bot.

body:
## 🐛 Bug Report
SafeAreaView does not have setNativeProps like View

## To Reproduce

Call `ref.current.setNativeProps()`

## Expected Behavior
SafeAreaView should support this just like the View does.

## Code Example

https://snack.expo.io/@brunolemos/safeareaview-setnativeprops

```jsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { View, SafeAreaView } from 'react-native';

export default class App extends React.PureComponent {
  render() {
    return (
      <>
        <View
          ref={ref =>
            ref && alert(`View has setNativeProps: ${'setNativeProps' in ref}`)
          }
        />
        <SafeAreaView
          ref={ref =>
            ref &&
            alert(`SafeAreaView has setNativeProps: ${'setNativeProps' in ref}`)
          }
        />
      </>
    );
  }
}
```
